facts.text: Passenger-car validation precedents cover AEB and crash-avoidance performance under Euro NCAP, and assisted driving under UNECE Regulation 171 for Driver Control Assistance Systems (DCAS).
facts.quote: AEB and crash-avoidance performance (Euro NCAP), and assisted driving under UNECE Regulation 171 (Driver Control Assistance Systems, DCAS).

facts.text: Euro NCAP 2026 Virtual Testing is identified as the clearest collision-avoidance example of simulation evidence accepted by an external assessor.
facts.quote: This is the clearest collision-avoidance example of simulation evidence accepted by an external assessor.

facts.text: Euro NCAP's supporting protocol “Safe Driving & Crash Avoidance Virtual Testing” is version 1.00, dated March 2025.
facts.quote: Euro NCAP's supporting protocol "Safe Driving & Crash Avoidance Virtual Testing" (version 1.00, March 2025)

entities.name: Safe Driving & Crash Avoidance Virtual Testing

facts.text: Euro NCAP's virtual-testing protocol requires the manufacturer's simulation model to correlate with physical testing using ISO-based scores and key performance indicators before virtual predictions are run.
facts.quote: the manufacturer's simulation model must first correlate with physical testing using ISO-based scores and key performance indicators

facts.text: After initial model correlation, the manufacturer runs virtual prediction grids under Euro NCAP's virtual-testing protocol.
facts.quote: the manufacturer then runs virtual prediction grids

facts.text: Euro NCAP selects random cells from manufacturers' virtual prediction grids for physical verification.
facts.quote: Euro NCAP chooses random grid cells for physical verification

facts.text: A failed correlation under Euro NCAP's virtual-testing protocol can force re-simulation.
facts.quote: a failed correlation can force re-simulation

facts.text: Euro NCAP's 2026 announcement says driver-assistance systems will be judged both on test-track crash-prevention abilities and during real-world driving, in response to complaints about annoying warnings or intrusive interventions.
facts.quote: "not only on their crash-prevention abilities on the test track, but also during real-world driving," because of complaints about "annoying warnings or intrusive interventions"

facts.text: For vulnerable-road-user AEB, the manufacturer submits predicted performance and Euro NCAP verifies the predictions through sample tests.
facts.quote: For vulnerable-road-user AEB, the manufacturer submits predicted performance and Euro NCAP verifies it with sample tests

facts.text: Tool vendor AVL describes Euro NCAP's 2026 regime as accepting simulation under strict rules, with dossier submission and spot-check verification.
facts.quote: AVL, a tool vendor, describes the 2026 regime as simulation "accepted under strict rules ... with dossier submission and spot-check verification"

facts.text: An IDIADA and MathWorks demonstration recorded on 14 April 2026 showed closed-loop virtual sensors, vehicle dynamics and an AEB controller correlated against production-vehicle proving-ground tests using ISO 18571 metrics.
facts.quote: An IDIADA and MathWorks demonstration recorded on 14 April 2026 showed closed-loop virtual sensors, vehicle dynamics and an AEB controller correlated against proving-ground tests of a production vehicle using ISO 18571 metrics

facts.text: The IDIADA and MathWorks demonstration recorded on 14 April 2026 included far more scenario variants than earlier protocol generations.
facts.quote: with far more scenario variants than earlier protocol generations

facts.text: The IDIADA and MathWorks demonstration recorded on 14 April 2026 is not evidence that a specific vehicle received a rating through the demonstrated virtual-testing process.
facts.quote: it is a demonstration, not evidence that a specific vehicle received a rating this way

facts.text: Euro NCAP is an independent consumer-assessment body, not a type-approval regulator.
facts.quote: Euro NCAP is an independent consumer-assessment body, not a type-approval regulator.

facts.text: Per-manufacturer build time and validation time for Euro NCAP virtual testing were not found.
facts.quote: Per-manufacturer build time and validation time: not found.

facts.text: Euro NCAP virtual testing retains physical qualification tests and Euro NCAP's selected physical verification tests.
facts.quote: Physical testing retained: the qualification tests plus Euro NCAP's selected verification tests.

facts.text: Acceptance under UNECE R171 for Driver Control Assistance Systems is by type-approval authorities.
facts.quote: **UNECE R171 (DCAS).** Acceptance is by type-approval authorities.

facts.text: According to vendor dSPACE, UNECE WP.29 added virtual testing to R171 at the end of 2024.
facts.quote: UNECE WP.29 added virtual testing to R171 at the end of 2024, according to dSPACE (a vendor source)

facts.text: An Applied Intuition vendor blog says R171 tests are expected to be performed through physical tests and trials.
facts.quote: An Applied Intuition blog (vendor) says R171 tests are "expected to be performed through physical tests and trials,"

facts.text: According to Applied Intuition's vendor blog, R171 allows virtual testing for certain scenarios that are difficult to reproduce, provided the toolchain undergoes a rigorous credibility evaluation.
facts.quote: with virtual testing allowed "for certain scenarios that are difficult to reproduce, provided the toolchain went through a rigorous credibility evaluation"

facts.text: UNECE GRVA informal document GRVA-18-55 from January 2024 found that the proposal to add virtual testing to Regulation 152 for AEB did not address all the identified aspects of credible virtual-testing capability.
facts.quote: A UNECE GRVA informal document from January 2024 (GRVA-18-55) found that the proposal to add virtual testing to Regulation 152 (AEB) "does not address all the above aspects of a credible virtual testing capability"

facts.text: The January 2024 UNECE GRVA finding is independent regulatory-working-group evidence that AEB virtual testing was not yet considered credible enough at that point.
facts.quote: That is independent regulatory-working-group evidence that AEB virtual testing was not yet considered credible enough at that point.

facts.text: The VMAD group developed UNECE's New Assessment/Test Method (NATM) framework.
facts.quote: the New Assessment/Test Method, NATM, developed by the VMAD group

facts.text: UNECE's NATM framework treats simulation and virtual testing as one evidence pillar alongside track testing, real-world testing and audit.
facts.quote: treats simulation and virtual testing as one evidence pillar beside track testing, real-world testing and audit

facts.text: TÜV SÜD summarizes current European automated-driving regulation and ISO 34502 as requiring the virtual platform itself to be demonstrated fit for purpose.
facts.quote: TÜV SÜD summarizes current European automated-driving regulation and ISO 34502 as requiring the virtual platform itself to be shown fit for purpose

facts.text: In the UNECE virtual-testing context, physical tests remain the default and virtual results are spot-checked.
facts.quote: Physical tests remain the default, and virtual results are spot-checked.
